import Lean

namespace MathGKM.ContinuationObligations

inductive Instruction where
  | request | accept | attach | review | proposeRewrite | install | stop
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq

structure Program where
  code : List Instruction
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq

structure State where
  program : Program
  archive : List String
  agenda : List String
  pending : Option String
  history : List String
  clock : Nat
  resource : Nat
  deriving Repr

/-- Responses and delays are inputs. No probability of proposer success. -/
structure Input where
  response : String
  delay : Nat
  nextProgram : Option Program
  deriving Repr

/-- This is a declared model, not the study's host implementation. Both
continuations may change code at every future step, including after a switch. -/
def step (s : State) (i : Input) : State :=
  match s.program.code with
  | [] => s
  | instruction :: rest =>
    let t := { s with program := ⟨rest⟩,
      history := s.history ++ [i.response], clock := s.clock + i.delay + 1,
      resource := s.resource - (i.delay + 1) }
    match instruction with
    | .request => { t with pending := some i.response }
    | .accept => { t with archive := t.archive ++ [i.response], pending := none }
    | .attach => { t with archive := t.archive ++ [i.response] }
    | .review => { t with agenda := t.agenda ++ [i.response] }
    | .proposeRewrite => { t with pending := some i.response }
    | .install => { t with program := i.nextProgram.getD t.program }
    | .stop => { t with program := ⟨[]⟩ }

def run (n : Nat) (s : State) (env : Nat → Input) : State :=
  match n with
  | 0 => s
  | n+1 => step (run n s env) (env n)

structure Installation where
  candidate : Program
  validationCost : Nat
  migrationCost : Nat
  deadline : Nat

def install (i : Installation) (s : State) : Option State :=
  let cost := i.validationCost + i.migrationCost
  if s.clock + cost ≤ i.deadline ∧ cost ≤ s.resource then
    some { s with program := i.candidate, clock := s.clock + cost,
                  resource := s.resource - cost }
  else none

/-- A whole trace includes all subsequent code, proposals and installations.
The chosen semantics must refine actual effects; arbitrary values are not an
implementation bridge. This declaration keeps that obligation explicit. -/
abbrev Trace := Nat → State

structure WholeSemantics where
  continue : State → (Nat → Input) → Trace
  initial : ∀ s env, continue s env 0 = s
  successor : ∀ s env n, continue s env (n+1) = step (continue s env n) (env n)

def operationalSemantics : WholeSemantics where
  continue := fun s env n => run n s env
  initial := fun _ _ => rfl
  successor := fun _ _ _ => rfl

/-- The whole trace is now determined by executable steps at every horizon. -/
theorem continuation_eq_run (sem : WholeSemantics) (s : State) (env : Nat → Input)
    (n : Nat) : sem.continue s env n = run n s env := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact sem.initial s env
  | succ n ih => rw [sem.successor, ih]; rfl

def WholeSwitch (sem : WholeSemantics) (utility : Trace → Int)
    (environmentClass : (Nat → Input) → Prop) (s : State) (i : Installation) : Prop :=
  ∃ t, install i s = some t ∧
    ∀ env, environmentClass env → utility (sem.continue s env) < utility (sem.continue t env)

/-- No hypothesis here asserts global proof-system soundness. This bundle is
an obligation type, not a discharged concrete switch certificate. -/
structure ImplementationBinding (HostState HostInput : Type) (sem : WholeSemantics) where
  encode : HostState → State
  encodeInput : HostInput → Input
  hostStep : HostState → HostInput → HostState
  simulates : ∀ s i, encode (hostStep s i) = step (encode s) (encodeInput i)
  contractBytes : String
  incumbentBytes : String
  candidateBytes : String
  migrationBytes : String
  costInterpretation : String
  environmentAssumptions : String

def hostRun {S I : Type} (transition : S → I → S) (n : Nat)
    (s : S) (env : Nat → I) : S :=
  match n with
  | 0 => s
  | n+1 => transition (hostRun transition n s env) (env n)

/-- A local simulation extends to the WHOLE trace, including later installs.
This is useful only after supplying a concrete host simulation; it does not
assume or prove any favorable utility comparison. -/
theorem ImplementationBinding.whole_trace {S I : Type} {sem : WholeSemantics}
    (b : ImplementationBinding S I sem) (s : S) (env : Nat → I) (n : Nat) :
    b.encode (hostRun b.hostStep n s env) =
      sem.continue (b.encode s) (fun k => b.encodeInput (env k)) n := by
  rw [continuation_eq_run]
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    change b.encode (b.hostStep (hostRun b.hostStep n s env) (env n)) = _
    rw [b.simulates, ih]
    rfl

/-- Inhabited model instance, not an assertion about Python/OS/model calls. -/
def modelBinding : ImplementationBinding State Input operationalSemantics where
  encode := id
  encodeInput := id
  hostStep := step
  simulates := fun _ _ => rfl
  contractBytes := "model-only"
  incumbentBytes := "state.program"
  candidateBytes := "input.nextProgram"
  migrationBytes := "install"
  costInterpretation := "natural steps and input delays"
  environmentAssumptions := "arbitrary input streams"

theorem zero_installation_preserves_baseline (s : State) :
    install ⟨s.program, 0, 0, s.clock⟩ s = some s := by
  simp [install]

-- Codex/Astra. Executed by machinery.engine as its transition guard.
-- Payload, filesystem atomicity, broker execution and OS costs remain outside this model.
import Lean
import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega

open Lean
namespace MathGKM.Protocol
structure State where
  pending : Option String := none
  consumed : List String := []
  count : Nat := 0
  limit : Nat := 32
  inflight : Bool := false
  deriving ToJson, FromJson, Repr

inductive Command where
  | issue (id : String)
  | claim (id : String)
  | record
  | finish
  deriving ToJson, FromJson, Repr

def step (s : State) (c : Command) : Option State :=
  match c with
  | .issue id => if s.pending.isNone && !s.inflight then
      some {s with pending := some id} else none
  | .claim id => if s.pending == some id && !s.inflight && !(s.consumed.contains id) then
      some {s with consumed := id :: s.consumed, inflight := true} else none
  | .record => if s.inflight && s.count < s.limit then
      some {s with count := s.count + 1} else none
  | .finish => if s.inflight then some {s with pending := none, inflight := false} else none

theorem preserves_budget (s t : State) (c : Command)
    (h : s.count ≤ s.limit) (accepted : step s c = some t) : t.count ≤ t.limit := by
  cases c <;> simp only [step] at accepted
  all_goals split at accepted <;> simp_all
  all_goals subst t <;> simp_all <;> omega

theorem recorded_only_inflight (s t : State) (h : step s .record = some t) :
    s.inflight = true ∧ t.count = s.count + 1 := by
  simp only [step] at h
  split at h <;> simp_all
  subst t
  rfl

theorem no_replayed_claim (s : State) (id : String) (h : id ∈ s.consumed) :
    step s (.claim id) = none := by
  simp [step, h]

structure Invocation where
  state : State
  command : Command
  deriving FromJson
end MathGKM.Protocol

open Lean MathGKM.Protocol

def main (args : List String) : IO UInt32 := do
  match args with
  | [filename] =>
    let raw ← IO.FS.readFile filename
    match Json.parse raw >>= fromJson? (α := Invocation) with
    | .error e => IO.eprintln e; return 1
    | .ok r =>
      match step r.state r.command with
      | none => IO.eprintln "protocol transition rejected"; return 2
      | some s => IO.println (toJson s).compress; return 0
  | _ => return 1

every old model with a compatible extension; it is a substantive obligation. -/
structure ConservativeExtension (Base : Type u) (Extended : Type v) where
  forget : Extended → Base
  extend : Base → Extended
  forget_extend : ∀ b, forget (extend b) = b

namespace ConservativeExtension
variable {B : Type u} {E : Type v} {F : Type w}

theorem preserves (a : ConservativeExtension B E) (P : B → Prop)
    (h : ∀ b, P b) : ∀ e, P (a.forget e) := fun e => h (a.forget e)

theorem reflects (a : ConservativeExtension B E) (P : B → Prop)
    (h : ∀ e, P (a.forget e)) : ∀ b, P b := by
  intro b
  simpa only [a.forget_extend b] using h (a.extend b)

def compose (a : ConservativeExtension B E) (b : ConservativeExtension E F) :
    ConservativeExtension B F where
  forget := a.forget ∘ b.forget
  extend := b.extend ∘ a.extend
  forget_extend := by intro x; simp [Function.comp_def, b.forget_extend, a.forget_extend]

/-- An uninhabited fiber would invalidate this construction. -/
def attach (B : Type u) (Cell : B → Type v) (witness : ∀ b, Cell b) :
    ConservativeExtension B (Sigma Cell) where
  forget := Sigma.fst
  extend := fun b => ⟨b, witness b⟩
  forget_extend := fun _ => rfl
end ConservativeExtension

/-- Exact observational transport, not mere agreement of type names. -/
structure Representation (A : Type u) (B : Type v) (P : A → Prop) (Q : B → Prop) where
  forward : A → B
  law : ∀ a, Q (forward a) ↔ P a

theorem Representation.consume {A : Type u} {B : Type v} {P : A → Prop} {Q : B → Prop}
    (r : Representation A B P Q) (h : ∀ b, Q b) : ∀ a, P a :=
  fun a => (r.law a).mp (h (r.forward a))

theorem collision_obstructs_transport {A : Type u} {B : Type v}
    (f : A → B) (P : A → Prop) (Q : B → Prop) (a b : A)
    (same : f a = f b) (different : ¬ (P a ↔ P b)) :
    ¬ (∀ x, Q (f x) ↔ P x) := by
  intro h
  apply different
  exact (h a).symm.trans (by simpa only [same] using h b)

/-- The semantic gluing here is a pullback of model interpretations, not a
symbol union and not an assertion about arbitrary dependent source edits. -/
def Compatible {B : Type u} {L : Type v} {R : Type w} (l : L → B) (r : R → B) :=
  {p : L × R // l p.1 = r p.2}

def glue {B : Type u} {L : Type v} {R : Type w} {X : Type z}
    (l : L → B) (r : R → B) (f : X → L) (g : X → R)
    (commutes : ∀ x, l (f x) = r (g x)) : X → Compatible l r :=
  fun x => ⟨(f x, g x), commutes x⟩

theorem glue_unique {B : Type u} {L : Type v} {R : Type w} {X : Type z}
    (l : L → B) (r : R → B) (f : X → L) (g : X → R)
    (commutes : ∀ x, l (f x) = r (g x)) (h : X → Compatible l r)
    (left : ∀ x, (h x).val.1 = f x) (right : ∀ x, (h x).val.2 = g x) :
    h = glue l r f g commutes := by
  funext x
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact Prod.ext (left x) (right x)

/-- Families over a base have a concrete cocartesian extension: dependent sum
over each fiber of the base map. The following factorization is its universal
property. No model-category cofibration is claimed. -/
def Push {I : Type u} {J : Type v} (f : I → J) (F : I → Type w) (j : J) :=
  Σ i, {x : F i // f i = j}

def pushUnit {I : Type u} {J : Type v} (f : I → J) (F : I → Type w)
    (i : I) (x : F i) : Push f F (f i) := ⟨i, x, rfl⟩

def pushLift {I : Type u} {J : Type v} {f : I → J} {F : I → Type w}
    {G : J → Type z} (h : ∀ i, F i → G (f i)) : ∀ j, Push f F j → G j :=
  fun _ ⟨i, x, eq⟩ => eq ▸ h i x

theorem push_beta {I : Type u} {J : Type v} {f : I → J} {F : I → Type w}
    {G : J → Type z} (h : ∀ i, F i → G (f i)) (i : I) (x : F i) :
    pushLift h (f i) (pushUnit f F i x) = h i x := rfl

theorem push_unique {I : Type u} {J : Type v} {f : I → J} {F : I → Type w}
    {G : J → Type z} (h : ∀ i, F i → G (f i))
    (k : ∀ j, Push f F j → G j)
    (beta : ∀ i x, k (f i) (pushUnit f F i x) = h i x) : k = pushLift h := by
  funext j p
  rcases p with ⟨i, x, eq⟩
  cases eq
  exact beta i x

      history := s.history ++ [i.response], clock := s.clock + i.delay + 1,
      resource := s.resource - (i.delay + 1) }
    match instruction with
    | .request => { t with pending := some i.response }
    | .accept => { t with archive := t.archive ++ [i.response], pending := none }
    | .attach => { t with archive := t.archive ++ [i.response] }
    | .review => { t with agenda := t.agenda ++ [i.response] }
    | .proposeRewrite => { t with pending := some i.response }
    | .install => { t with program := i.nextProgram.getD t.program }
    | .stop => { t with program := ⟨[]⟩ }

def run (n : Nat) (s : State) (env : Nat → Input) : State :=
  match n with
  | 0 => s
  | n+1 => step (run n s env) (env n)

structure Installation where
  candidate : Program
  validationCost : Nat
  migrationCost : Nat
  deadline : Nat

def install (i : Installation) (s : State) : Option State :=
  let cost := i.validationCost + i.migrationCost
  if s.clock + cost ≤ i.deadline ∧ cost ≤ s.resource then
    some { s with program := i.candidate, clock := s.clock + cost,
                  resource := s.resource - cost }
  else none

implementation bridge. This declaration keeps that obligation explicit. -/

structure WholeSemantics where
  continue : State → (Nat → Input) → Trace

  successor : ∀ s env n, continue s env (n+1) = step (continue s env n) (env n)

  successor := fun _ _ _ => rfl

    (n : Nat) : sem.continue s env n = run n s env := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact sem.initial s env
  | succ n ih => rw [sem.successor, ih]; rfl

def WholeSwitch (sem : WholeSemantics) (utility : Trace → Int)
    (environmentClass : (Nat → Input) → Prop) (s : State) (i : Installation) : Prop :=
  ∃ t, install i s = some t ∧
    ∀ env, environmentClass env → utility (sem.continue s env) < utility (sem.continue t env)

an obligation type, not a discharged concrete switch certificate. -/
structure ImplementationBinding (HostState HostInput : Type) (sem : WholeSemantics) where
  encode : HostState → State
  encodeInput : HostInput → Input
  hostStep : HostState → HostInput → HostState
  simulates : ∀ s i, encode (hostStep s i) = step (encode s) (encodeInput i)
  contractBytes : String
  incumbentBytes : String
  candidateBytes : String
  migrationBytes : String
  costInterpretation : String
  environmentAssumptions : String

    (s : S) (env : Nat → I) : S :=
  match n with
  | 0 => s
  | n+1 => transition (hostRun transition n s env) (env n)

This is useful only after supplying a concrete host simulation; it does not
assume or prove any favorable utility comparison. -/
theorem ImplementationBinding.whole_trace {S I : Type} {sem : WholeSemantics}
    (b : ImplementationBinding S I sem) (s : S) (env : Nat → I) (n : Nat) :
    b.encode (hostRun b.hostStep n s env) =
      sem.continue (b.encode s) (fun k => b.encodeInput (env k)) n := by
  rw [continuation_eq_run]
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    change b.encode (b.hostStep (hostRun b.hostStep n s env) (env n)) = _
    rw [b.simulates, ih]
    rfl

def modelBinding : ImplementationBinding State Input operationalSemantics where
  encode := id
  encodeInput := id
  hostStep := step
  simulates := fun _ _ => rfl
  contractBytes := "model-only"
  incumbentBytes := "state.program"
  candidateBytes := "input.nextProgram"
  migrationBytes := "install"
  costInterpretation := "natural steps and input delays"
  environmentAssumptions := "arbitrary input streams"

theorem zero_installation_preserves_baseline (s : State) :
    install ⟨s.program, 0, 0, s.clock⟩ s = some s := by
  simp [install]

-- Payload, filesystem atomicity, broker execution and OS costs remain outside this model.
import Lean
import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega

open Lean
namespace MathGKM.Protocol
structure State where
  pending : Option String := none
  consumed : List String := []
  count : Nat := 0
  limit : Nat := 32
  inflight : Bool := false
  deriving ToJson, FromJson, Repr

inductive Command where
  | issue (id : String)
  | claim (id : String)
  | record
  | finish
  deriving ToJson, FromJson, Repr

def step (s : State) (c : Command) : Option State :=
  match c with
  | .issue id => if s.pending.isNone && !s.inflight then
      some {s with pending := some id} else none
  | .claim id => if s.pending == some id && !s.inflight && !(s.consumed.contains id) then
      some {s with consumed := id :: s.consumed, inflight := true} else none
  | .record => if s.inflight && s.count < s.limit then
      some {s with count := s.count + 1} else none
  | .finish => if s.inflight then some {s with pending := none, inflight := false} else none

theorem preserves_budget (s t : State) (c : Command)
    (h : s.count ≤ s.limit) (accepted : step s c = some t) : t.count ≤ t.limit := by
  cases c <;> simp only [step] at accepted
  all_goals split at accepted <;> simp_all
  all_goals subst t <;> simp_all <;> omega

theorem recorded_only_inflight (s t : State) (h : step s .record = some t) :
    s.inflight = true ∧ t.count = s.count + 1 := by
  simp only [step] at h
  split at h <;> simp_all
  subst t
  rfl

theorem no_replayed_claim (s : State) (id : String) (h : id ∈ s.consumed) :
    step s (.claim id) = none := by
  simp [step, h]

structure Invocation where
  state : State
  command : Command
  deriving FromJson
end MathGKM.Protocol

open Lean MathGKM.Protocol

def main (args : List String) : IO UInt32 := do
  match args with
  | [filename] =>
    let raw ← IO.FS.readFile filename
    match Json.parse raw >>= fromJson? (α := Invocation) with
    | .error e => IO.eprintln e; return 1
    | .ok r =>
      match step r.state r.command with
      | none => IO.eprintln "protocol transition rejected"; return 2
      | some s => IO.println (toJson s).compress; return 0
  | _ => return 1

every old model with a compatible extension; it is a substantive obligation. -/
structure ConservativeExtension (Base : Type u) (Extended : Type v) where
  forget : Extended → Base
  extend : Base → Extended
  forget_extend : ∀ b, forget (extend b) = b

namespace ConservativeExtension
variable {B : Type u} {E : Type v} {F : Type w}

theorem preserves (a : ConservativeExtension B E) (P : B → Prop)
    (h : ∀ b, P b) : ∀ e, P (a.forget e) := fun e => h (a.forget e)

theorem reflects (a : ConservativeExtension B E) (P : B → Prop)
    (h : ∀ e, P (a.forget e)) : ∀ b, P b := by
  intro b
  simpa only [a.forget_extend b] using h (a.extend b)

def compose (a : ConservativeExtension B E) (b : ConservativeExtension E F) :
    ConservativeExtension B F where
  forget := a.forget ∘ b.forget
  extend := b.extend ∘ a.extend
  forget_extend := by intro x; simp [Function.comp_def, b.forget_extend, a.forget_extend]

/-- An uninhabited fiber would invalidate this construction. -/
def attach (B : Type u) (Cell : B → Type v) (witness : ∀ b, Cell b) :
    ConservativeExtension B (Sigma Cell) where
  forget := Sigma.fst
  extend := fun b => ⟨b, witness b⟩
  forget_extend := fun _ => rfl
end ConservativeExtension

/-- Exact observational transport, not mere agreement of type names. -/
structure Representation (A : Type u) (B : Type v) (P : A → Prop) (Q : B → Prop) where
  forward : A → B
  law : ∀ a, Q (forward a) ↔ P a

theorem Representation.consume {A : Type u} {B : Type v} {P : A → Prop} {Q : B → Prop}
    (r : Representation A B P Q) (h : ∀ b, Q b) : ∀ a, P a :=
  fun a => (r.law a).mp (h (r.forward a))

theorem collision_obstructs_transport {A : Type u} {B : Type v}
    (f : A → B) (P : A → Prop) (Q : B → Prop) (a b : A)
    (same : f a = f b) (different : ¬ (P a ↔ P b)) :
    ¬ (∀ x, Q (f x) ↔ P x) := by

  apply different
  exact (h a).symm.trans (by simpa only [same] using h b)

symbol union and not an assertion about arbitrary dependent source edits. -/
def Compatible {B : Type u} {L : Type v} {R : Type w} (l : L → B) (r : R → B) :=
  {p : L × R // l p.1 = r p.2}

def glue {B : Type u} {L : Type v} {R : Type w} {X : Type z}
    (l : L → B) (r : R → B) (f : X → L) (g : X → R)
    (commutes : ∀ x, l (f x) = r (g x)) : X → Compatible l r :=
  fun x => ⟨(f x, g x), commutes x⟩

theorem glue_unique {B : Type u} {L : Type v} {R : Type w} {X : Type z}
    (l : L → B) (r : R → B) (f : X → L) (g : X → R)
    (commutes : ∀ x, l (f x) = r (g x)) (h : X → Compatible l r)
    (left : ∀ x, (h x).val.1 = f x) (right : ∀ x, (h x).val.2 = g x) :

  apply Subtype.ext

def Push {I : Type u} {J : Type v} (f : I → J) (F : I → Type w) (j : J) :=

    (i : I) (x : F i) : Push f F (f i) := ⟨i, x, rfl⟩

def pushLift {I : Type u} {J : Type v} {f : I → J} {F : I → Type w}
    {G : J → Type z} (h : ∀ i, F i → G (f i)) : ∀ j, Push f F j → G j :=
  fun _ ⟨i, x, eq⟩ => eq ▸ h i x

theorem push_beta {I : Type u} {J : Type v} {f : I → J} {F : I → Type w}
    {G : J → Type z} (h : ∀ i, F i → G (f i)) (i : I) (x : F i) :
    pushLift h (f i) (pushUnit f F i x) = h i x := rfl

theorem push_unique {I : Type u} {J : Type v} {f : I → J} {F : I → Type w}
    {G : J → Type z} (h : ∀ i, F i → G (f i))
    (k : ∀ j, Push f F j → G j)

  funext j p
